suite: 12 of 20 existing MetadataAssociations name collections that are not in CMR (L1B V2-08, L2O V2-01, L2O Mode 7.1 V3-00).
Every existing association links the preceding/succeeding release, typed PARENT/CHILD; none records the L1B → L2O processing lineage.
The linked ATBD (Release 1.0, June 2015) leaves the Level 2 Operational algorithms "to be outlined … in future releases"; no later ATBD is linked.

The linked quality statements (L1B 2.08, L2O Profile 2.01) and Release Notes describe the sixth release (L1B V2.08, L2O V2.00/2.01), not V3; no V3 quality statement or release notes are linked or published at ASDC.
Only two records link a quality statement (PRODUCT QUALITY ASSESSMENT); the L2O Layer quality statement exists at ASDC but no record links it.

2 of 17 linked pages return HTTP 404 (the GENERAL DOCUMENTATION and DATA CITATION GUIDELINES pages linked from all 16 records); 0 cats.gsfc.nasa.gov links (project home page, browse imagery, DPC copy) timed out from this environment.

DPC Release 7.0 inconsistencies: the Layer product section is labelled "V1-02 Corresponds to V3_00 L2 Product Software"; the example file names are dated 2014-09-17 (before launch); the NRT example is named "M7.1" although NRT was Mode 7.2 only; section number 2.2 is used twice.
No granule fills InputGranules, although every L2O file records L1_Input_Version_Number and its L1B granule shares the same start/stop time.
